question: A solid cylindrical shaft, 2 in. dia. 18 in. long, is used for the transmission of mechanical power at a rate of 45 hp running at 1500 rpm. The modulus of rigidity for the material used is 14 × 10^6 psi. Calculate a) the shear stress acting on the shaft; b) the torsional deflection of the shaft.

options.A: Shear stress is approximately 1300 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.095 degrees
options.B: Shear stress is approximately 1500 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.110 degrees
options.C: Shear stress is approximately 1204 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.089 degrees
options.D: Shear stress is approximately 950 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.075 degrees
options.E: Shear stress is approximately 800 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.065 degrees
options.F: Shear stress is approximately 1000 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.080 degrees
options.G: Shear stress is approximately 1400 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.105 degrees
options.H: Shear stress is approximately 900 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.070 degrees
options.I: Shear stress is approximately 1600 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.120 degrees
options.J: Shear stress is approximately 1100 psi and torsional deflection is approximately 0.100 degrees
